sloka: करिष्यामि भविष्यामि सर्ववाच्यो विवक्षताम् ।अहमिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन सगरेण विवर्धतः ॥५-१-८९॥
transliteration: kariṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi sarvavācyo vivakṣatām ।ahamikṣvākunāthena sagareṇa vivardhataḥ ॥5-1-89॥

translations.english: 'I expanded on account of a scion of the Ikshvaku race (Sagara) and I should not do anything to make him (Hanuman) suffer since he is the minister helping the Ikshvaku race'.
